title: Which Box Hides the Diamond?
youtube_description:
Can YOU find the diamond? Watch all three boxes get revealed and see if you guessed right! Drop your answer in the comments! 👇

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Kidify #FunForKids #DiamondChallenge #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these boxes hides a REAL diamond! Which one is it?
Is it the red box, the blue box, or the golden box? Pick one — fast!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue gold gift boxes row

scenes.narration: Opening the RED box and… it's a rubber chicken! Nope, not even close!
What about the BLUE box? Oh no — it's just a soggy old sandwich! Gross!
That means the GOLDEN box has the diamond! Let's open it… YES! There it is! Sparkling and beautiful!
Did you pick gold? You're a genius! Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
